text_block_list.text: And as summer drew to a close—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Well done! You guys are the absolute best!"

text_block_list.name: 2 Fellow Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah, Tap~!
Uuuugh, Tap...!
choice_data_list: You two really gave it your all.
You two really worked so hard.

text_block_list.name: 2 Fellow Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Traineeeer~!

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I... I just can't bring myself to give up~.
I mean, this summer is...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
To think our time together is coming to an end.
Anything but that... I can't accept it!

Yes, that day Tap Dance City
decided to support her companions to the very end...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, one more time.
Lift your heads up once more!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's true we've got nothin' to our names!
Except for one single, precious thing...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Are you guys seriously planning to throw away
even the time we spend together!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"What's left if you do that? What do we even live for?
What was our encounter even for—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You're saying they're just worthless trash floating in the ocean?!
That's not true at all, is it?!

Putting heart and soul into rallying them, she stirred the two up.
With those words, the sinking ship
somehow managed to recover.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!! We're crew for life!
Like hell I'd let anyone jump ship against their will!
One somehow managed to secure a debut, while the other claimed a victory at the end of summer to remain active. And what's more...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good, good! Looks like they managed to get through
the mock exams and everything else in one piece.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Once we're back at Tracen Academy, we'll regroup!
Let's all keep our spirits high together!

text_block_list.name: 2 Fellow Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

Tap Dance City's ship safely regained its balance.
Meanwhile—
Another vessel that had invaded from foreign waters was beginning to wreak havoc as well.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf-san, we have high hopes for the Symboli family's foreign import in the future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A reinforcement... an import player?
No, no—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Kris S is no mere guest helper.
She is a full-fledged member of the Symboli family.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All who carry the name of Symboli are of one family.
I hope you will cheer for her just the same.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... "shikai".
I do not know what that means, but――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I want to repay my debt.
As one of the Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S...
An Umamusume raised in the USA, just like me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I've never raced alongside her.
But word is she's a monster who never lets her prey escape.
choice_data_list: Is your background a bit similar to Tap's?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well. But even though it's the same American—
that one over there is higher quality.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Over there, she had a home from the start,
while I'm still no home, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: But! That ends this year!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If I play my cards right by the end of the year,
I'll finally have my precious base of operations...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We'll get a 'home sweet home' where we can spend time with everyone.
Right, Trainer?!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this then.
At our next goal, the Challenge Cup—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely pull it off!
It's my time to shine!
